summary: Feed s062_single to APM is degraded: 27.1% duplicate packets (1150/4238) exceeds 5% threshold. All other visibility checks (one-way, drops, VLANs, encryption, overload) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packets are being delivered twice, most likely from aggregating the same traffic from two SPAN/mirror sources or dual TAP feeds through the packet broker without deduplication enabled. Broker is forwarding identical copies via overlapping paths.
findings.impact_on_tool: APM will double-count transactions and inflate throughput/latency metrics, skewing response-time calculations and application performance baselines, wasting CPU/storage and potentially triggering false performance alerts.

recommended_fix.why: Enable packet-broker hardware deduplication within a short time window to drop identical copies before delivery, restoring accurate transaction counts and preserving APM capacity without losing unique traffic.
